stops.segment: The Last Room, and What the Country Kept
stops.stop: New Delhi, the first stanza becomes an anthem
stops.date_confidence: attested: the Constituent Assembly adopted the first stanza of Jana Gana Mana on 24 January 1950 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jana_Gana_Mana).
